Giving Back to the Community
Balancing our reason to be in business with the values that keep us in
business is vital to our success. Our commitment to being an active
corporate citizen and engaging in the communities we serve is
always the foundation of our approach.
Through diverse initiatives and proven community partnerships,
we gave in excess of $2.5 million to more than 1,300 nonprofit
organizations in 2019. And our employees contributed their
time and talent with hundreds of non-profit organizations and
community causes. The company continued encouraging employee
involvement, through paid time off to all full- and part-time
employees to volunteer with organizations of their choice.
